summary: This CLI is a curated New Central subset (sync, brief, export, doctor, and the reads around them), not a full ReadMe-hub print.
reason: cli-printing-press was not available for this publication. A regen that emits all ~1,736 New Central operations would replace the customer-share surface; preserve the SQLite mirror, the 10 req/s client budget, Classic Central rejection, and writes gated on ENABLE_WRITES=1 plus --yes. The raw api command stays the escape hatch for paths without their own subcommand.
validated_outcome: go test ./... passed offline. doctor with an empty config exits 10 and names CENTRAL_BASE_URL, CENTRAL_CLIENT_ID, and CENTRAL_CLIENT_SECRET. A httptest sync fills SQLite and brief reports a down device, a critical alert, and firmware drift. No live customer tenant was called.
